name: Sono Hikari Sono Tsubasa ~Azathoth no Isan~
original_name: その光その翼～アザトースの遺産～
source:
Since he was young Kisaragi Touma had been sick from an unknown disease. The doctors who gave up one after the others and a life of being continually hospitalized forced him to face this battle alone.
But after being contacted by his father he hadn't seen in years, Touma moved to a huge medical facility in Hokkaido.
Finally making two friends, Yui and Marcus, his heart began to heal little by little.
But the facility hides a big secret that unravel little by little and trigger an event that could influence the whole world.
translation:
如月当麻从小就患有某种不明疾病。一个个放弃的医生和不断住院的生活迫使他独自面对这场战斗。
但在多年未见的父亲联系后，当麻搬到了北海道的一家大型医疗机构。
终于结识了结衣和马库斯两个朋友，他的心也开始一点点痊愈。
但该设施隐藏着一个大秘密，这个秘密逐渐被揭开，并引发了一场可能影响整个世界的事件。
